# 零经验做App，做到300万+下载

![封面图](https://storage.googleapis.com/indie-hackers.appspot.com/post-images/631uqYhZjlqT77hstusp/vOqaQ3DJwYRP8MNEjUOSMger71w1/ania-wysocka-founder-of-rootd.png)

**> 作者: Ania Wysocka**

**> 标签: B2B营销、B2C营销、品牌、移动应用、女性科技**

你有没有在恐慌发作时找不到帮助的经历？

Ania有。

大学时，离家远，没家庭医生，第一次panic attack。

本能伸手拿手机，但找不到任何apps帮忙，其他资源要么unhelpful、不是为像她这样的人设计的，要么simply unaffordable on student budget。

--

那经历planted the seed。

接下来几年，她dove into researching clinical papers、self-help books、expert conversations、whatever else could find。

Eventually realize想build exactly the app she had once searched for。

--

现在，她是Rootd创始人，帮人们manage和overcome anxiety、panic attacks的app。

--

Zero background in app development，但有deep motivation solve problem personally familiar with。

自己做了所有design、content、wireframes，找到student developer在学React Native。

Grow后transition到Flutter。

Out of pocket funded everything，意味着项目had to be tightly scoped、thoughtfully executed。

--

第一版只有两个features：panic button和lessons section。

花countless hours crafting copy的tone、choosing right color palette、perfecting mascot personality——Ron，打开app看到的blue monster。

All part of ensuring Rootd feel like safe、welcoming space for users in need。

--

Rootd现在包括suite of tools：panic button、guided deep breathing、lessons section rooted in cognitive behavioral therapy (CBT)、guided visualizations和sleep stories、journaling tool等。

Features laser focused on要么stopping panic attack in the moment，要么helping user overcome panic和anxiety long term。

--

Follow freemium model。

Core features（like panic button）always free。

Users可以unlock additional content through monthly、annual或lifetime subscriptions。

也开始expand B2B side，licensing Rootd to organizations想support他们的employees、members或communities。

Scientifically validated twice，many B2B partnerships的prerequisite。

--

Revenue随user base steadily grow。

Run ongoing experiments around pricing、placement、timing of subscription offers。

Addition of B2B partnerships opening new revenue streams。

Bootstrapped since day one。

Hardest和most rewarding decision。

Kept focused on building product users love，allowed have full control follow felt right的方向。

--

Very successful、rewarding、growing business now。

App available in 12 languages，used in 150+ countries，over 3 million downloads。

Not share numbers，但comfortable saying 2021年hit 5 figures MRR。

--

First users came through organic App Store search。

Obsessed over listing里every word、every screenshot、every metadata tag，当然app title和subtitle。

Since then growth continued through organic channels：app store features、podcast interviews、press coverage，most of all word of mouth。

Featured in Healthline、Cosmopolitan、TIME magazine，Apple和Google Play stores multiple times。

--

Now also expanding into B2B by partnering with organizations和businesses help他们的communities access Rootd。

--

From the beginning Rootd received life-changing user reviews。

Feedback constant reminder what building really resonates，helped push through tough parts。

Still read every single one。

Heartbeat of Rootd和clearest signal doing something meaningful。

--

给创始人的建议：

Pick problem you care deeply about，focus obsessively on solving it，make it easy for right people find you。

Have to be absolutely obsessed with problem solving。

Then just START!

Don't wait perfect product。

First version of Rootd incomplete compared to vision，但helped people!

That's what mattered。

Bootstrapping forces clarity、focus、alignment with users。

--

Challenges mostly from app development realities：

Resource constraints、bugs appearing at worst times、constantly having make hard decisions about how spend limited time for most impact。

If could do anything differently，would've quit job earlier go full-time on Rootd sooner。

Honestly，love where are now，deeply grateful for every step of journey。

--

Community support invaluable。

Local entrepreneur circles、founder networks、fellowships like Cartier Women's Initiative，surrounding herself with people on similar paths made huge difference。

--

下一步？

Want Rootd be most trusted app for anxiety和panic attack support，worldwide。

Almost 4 million users now，goal reach 10 million within next three years。

Also want deepen partnerships in healthcare、education、corporate wellness，support even more people wherever they are。

--
